arguments.summary: Initial checks confirmed that the 502s on the checkout page were due to an ingress idle timeout, the certificate alert was caused by an expired intermediate certificate that required manual replacement, and cron jobs ran in UTC time as expected. The failed-jobs backlog in the jobs database has been increasing, and I will now investigate the reasons for the failures and export the failed_jobs table for the postmortem.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Investigate the reasons for the failed jobs and address the backlog. No services will be restarted without prior approval.
